title: Landnam scene feedback
description: What is wrong with a scene, what to keep, and what inspires it. Written in the Scene Studio, read by every agent. Pins accumulate: a pin marked wrong is a standing rule for that scene even after it is resolved.

scene.description: Scene id this feedback belongs to.

mode.description: fix: the author knows what to do, so follow the pins and notes exactly. explore: the author does not know what will look good, so propose genuinely different directions that fix every wrong pin and borrow what the inspiration does well.

status.description: open: an agent should act on this. addressed: the agent has delivered and is waiting for review.

direction.description: Overall feel in the author's own words.

kind.description: wrong: change this and never bring it back. keep: this works, do not touch it.

note.description: What is wrong or good, in the author's own words.

at.description: Where the pin sits in the preview frame, 0 to 1.

viewport.description: ph: phone portrait 390x844. ls: phone landscape 926x428. dk: desktop 1440x900.

state.description: Stage fixture that was showing, so the view can be reproduced.

object.description: Scene object the pin points at, when there is one.

resolved.description: The author has confirmed this is fixed. A resolved wrong pin still applies.

likes.description: What about it the author likes.
